mapper.select:
select t1.*, COALESCE(today_pv, 0) as today_pv, COALESCE(today_uv, 0) as today_uv, COALESCE(today_uip, 0) as today_uip from t_link t1 left join t_link_stats_today t2 on t1.full_short_url = t2.full_short_url and t1.gid = t2.gid and t2.date = CURDATE() where t1.gid = #{gid} and t1.del_flag = 0 and t1.enable_status = 1
order by today_pv desc order by today_uv desc order by today_uip desc order by total_pv desc order by total_uv desc order by total_uip desc
